title: Supabase auth, CRUD and storage
description: Separate browser/server clients, sign-in and OAuth routes, typed notes CRUD, private storage and owner RLS.
limitations: Database RLS integration requires configured Supabase and explicit disposable-account test intent.
Lists cap at 100 notes; account-management UI is application-owned.

Install manifest packages and preserve shared package imports.
Register application routes and authorization explicitly; run module checks.
